summary: On the first morning the new hire sits down with their manager before meeting anyone else.
realLife: In a study of new hires at one large firm, those who met their manager on day one reported feeling accepted by the team sooner. A first-week one-on-one with the manager was also tied to a wider network of contacts at work.
sources: Portland State University scholarly record, Day 1 newcomer resources and adjustment study: https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/busadmin_fac/198
Atlassian Work Life, starting a new job and first week success: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/teamwork/starting-a-new-job-and-first-week-success
inGame: The new hire's job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module; the manager is the person whose job record is the supervisor at the same workplace, with a coworker tie to the player when the player is the new hire.

turns.summary: The manager is out and the new hire waits until a coworker steps in.
turns.writesBack: The coworker tie gets closer, and the manager tie starts late.

turns.summary: The manager only says a quick hello and hands the new hire off to HR.
turns.writesBack: The new hire feels unwelcome, and a mood dips.

turns.summary: A friendly coworker greets the new hire at the door before the manager arrives.
turns.writesBack: A friendly tie forms before the manager tie.
